steps.en: Add its marketplace, then install the plugin in Claude Code (Codex has the same pair)
steps.zh: 先加它的插件市场，再在 Claude Code 里安装（Codex 同理）

steps.en: Open the folder holding your repos and ask for a map
steps.zh: 打开装着各仓库的目录，让 agent 画图
steps.code: Make me a floorplan of this app.

steps.en: Scripts list files, imports, endpoints and requests, and match requests to endpoints
steps.zh: 脚本列出文件、导入、接口和请求，并把请求配到接口

steps.en: Its skill has your agent name the parts and describe every file and endpoint plainly
steps.zh: 它的 skill 让你的 agent 给各部分起名，用白话描述每个文件和接口

steps.en: Builds the map with Health and Screens, then opens it in your browser
steps.zh: 构建带体检和页面视图的地图，并在浏览器里打开

value.en: You can see and ask how your app fits together without reading its code, on your own machine
value.zh: 不读代码也能看清、追问应用各部分怎么连在一起，全程在本机
